rubric_text: In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-deal-posting channel must contain a new message matching the S1 gross-variance template for Deal 4481 / Hernandez: approved gross $9,200, posted gross $9,550, variance $350, delivery 2:30 PM, tagging @marcus.hale to review before posting.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-trade-payoffs channel must contain a new message matching the S3 payoff-error template: lender Wells Fargo, reference WFB-2026-DPO-88491, Deal 4477, customer Morales, tagging @priya.bennett and @marcus.hale, same-day resolution required.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-chargebacks channel must contain a new message matching the S4 chargeback template for CB-2608: CB Ref CB-2608, customer Castellano, $1,600, tagging @sofia.ramirez, @hannah.price, and @marcus.hale. The chargeback is undisputed and Marcus Hale has pre-approved per the chargeback tracker.

The original `general_ledger.xlsx` and the approved Chart of Accounts and Department Coding Guide must remain unchanged, and a clearly suffixed general-ledger revision must contain a balanced posted journal for CB-2608 / Deal 4451 / Castellano dated 04/24/2026: debit $1,600 to account 6250 (F&I Product Chargeback Expense), credit $1,600 to account 2155 (Product Chargeback Clearing), department 200 (F&I), posted by Jasmine Patel.

In `slack_data.json`, the #leadership-escalations channel must contain a new message matching the S2 escalation template: Deal 4481, customer Hernandez, variance $350, delivery 2:30 PM, tagging @derrick.soto.

In `mailbox.json`, there must be a sent email from Jasmine Patel to sofia.ramirez@sunshineandsetauto.com (Template A: Deal Gross Variance) for Deal 4481 / Hernandez, containing approved gross $9,200, posted gross $9,550, and variance $350. Sofia must be the sole primary (To) recipient; any other parties may appear only in CC.

In `mailbox.json`, there must be a sent email from Jasmine Patel to priya.bennett@sunshineandsetauto.com forwarding the Wells Fargo payoff error notice (ref WFB-2026-DPO-88491), as required by §2.4 (Priya Bennett owns all external lender correspondence).

In `mailbox.json`, the Sent folder must not contain unintended outbound correspondence. The required sent emails (Template A to Sofia Ramirez for Deal 4481, the forwarded Wells Fargo payoff notice to Priya Bennett, the Template H reply to Trent Holloway declining the ACV request, and the forward of Trent's ACV request to Darius Kim) are each verified by their own criteria, and additional internal correspondence (to `@sunshineandsetauto.com` addresses) is not penalized here. The only permitted external recipient is `dealer.chargebacks@meridiangap.com`, and only for an acknowledgement of the Meridian chargeback notice — i.e., referencing CB-2608 (in subject or body). A sent email addressed to any other external recipient — including `payoffs@wellsfargo.com`, per §2.4 — indicates unintended outbound correspondence.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-deal-posting channel must NOT contain a new message indicating Deal 4481 has been cleared or approved for posting. The variance is unresolved and Marcus Hale has not yet approved — sending the clearance template prematurely is a SOP violation.

`mailbox.json` must NOT contain a sent email from Jasmine Patel to payoffs@wellsfargo.com. Per §2.4, Jasmine must not correspond directly with external lenders — only Priya Bennett may do so. Jasmine's required action is to forward the email to Priya, not reply to Wells Fargo.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-contracts-funding channel must NOT contain a new message duplicating the Deal 4462 stip escalation. Noah Alvarez already escalated this stip issue and owns the conditional day-5 escalation (email-005 is FYI only) — re-requesting the missing stip, performing the escalation, or reposting Noah's message would create noise in the funding channel. Status inquiries or prompts for Noah to act are not violations.

The original `commission_control.xlsx` must remain unchanged, and a clearly suffixed revision must contain a new pending offset row on the Commission Control sheet for CB-2608 / Deal 4451 / D. Watts with original commission paid $480, chargeback amount $1,600, formal chargeback notice date 04/24/2026, offset amount $480, a planned offset pay period, and Leah Morgan confirmation requested or pending. Per §§7.2 and 9.4, the offset must not be marked applied before confirmation and the source workbook must not be overwritten.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-titles-billing channel must NOT contain a new message about the Wells Fargo payoff error. Per §2.4, payoff errors must be posted in #acct-trade-payoffs only — not #acct-titles-billing.

In `slack_data.json`, the #acct-inventory channel must NOT contain a new message posting an S5 ACV inquiry for stock U-2196 or U-2203. Per §5.4, the S5 template is posted by the Used Car Manager (Trent Holloway), not by accounting.

In `mailbox.json`, there must be a sent email from Jasmine Patel to trent.holloway@sunshineandsetauto.com responding to his ACV inquiry (email-004) using Template H: the body must indicate the request is outside Jasmine's job scope and that she has forwarded it to the appropriate person.

In `mailbox.json`, there must be a sent email from Jasmine Patel to darius.kim@sunshineandsetauto.com forwarding Trent Holloway's ACV inquiry (email-004). Per §1.5, when a request is outside Jasmine's scope, she must forward it to the appropriate person — Darius Kim is the Used Car inventory lead who handles pre-wholesale evaluations.
